prompt: Implement the approved Verrail B1 brand shell and primary navigation behind the Workspace flag, preserve compatibility identities, prove desktop and narrow browser behavior, and attach inspectable delivery evidence.
allowed_actions: Add reusable Verrail UI brand components
Update user-visible application, authentication, onboarding, document, favicon, and PWA brand surfaces
Add canonical navigation routes and flag-aware redirects
Add Home, Infrastructure, and Governance read-only UI skeletons over existing APIs
Update focused tests and user-visible English and Chinese translations
Run a local development server and create browser screenshots
forbidden_actions: Rename compatibility identifiers, commands, packages, APIs, telemetry, database fields, persisted keys, or runtime sentinels
Enable the new navigation by default or mutate production data
Introduce Temporal or Go runtime code
Ship, merge, deploy, or announce without explicit approval
expected_evidence: Focused brand, navigation, route, shell, and read-state tests
Typecheck, build, token, asset, translation, and diff results
stop_conditions: The navigation cannot remain Workspace-scoped and false by default
The UI would need to fabricate Target identity or write authority
Validation failure requires weakening existing contracts or tests
